A.title: Initial C51 payoff formula was unqualified outside its valid strike-order condition.
A.reported: max(K_P, min(S_T, K_C)) + C - P presented as the collar terminal value while no strikes were selected.
A.actual: The generally valid terminal value is min(S_T, K_C) + max(K_P - S_T, 0) + C - P. The compact expression is equivalent only when K_P <= K_C.
A.evidence: For K_P=150, K_C=100, S_T=200 and C=P=0, the actual value is 100 while the reviewed compact expression returns 150.
A.impact: The audited payoff boundary was wrong or incomplete. It cannot be accepted as correct formal evidence, even though C51 does not make a return or action claim.
A.required_remediation: Use the generally valid expression or state and enforce K_P <= K_C wherever the compact form is used; regenerate the two C51 outputs; then obtain a separate independent R21 repair recheck.

B.title: Future builder source validation is self-referential.
B.evidence: The builder fixes only expected source IDs, then accepts filenames and hashes from the mutable manifest. A coordinated raw-file and manifest substitution could pass. The PDF validation checks only the %PDF header and does not assert the interface terms used in the output boundary.
B.impact: The current retained source batch independently matches official URLs, but a future rebuild would not have an immutable source-identity or semantic-validation chain.
B.required_remediation: Pin expected ID, filename, URL and hash values in the builder, or bind an independently integrity-controlled manifest digest; assert extracted PDF terms relevant to the cited data categories.
